metadata.exg_method: ExG = 2G - R - B; min-max normalized; Otsu threshold; 3x3 opening/closing
metadata.zone_boost_formula: Bi=max(0, 1-V_input/Vref)*confidence; Vref=P95 of valid zone means; if P95-P25 gap <= configured cutoff, V_input=P25 for every zone, otherwise V_input=each zone mean
metadata.zone_specific_boost_formula: B_zone=max(0, 1-zone_mean_vari/Vref)*zone_confidence; shown for comparison even when P25 blanket mode is applied
metadata.zone_mean_vari_percentile_rank_definitio: 100 × number of valid zone means less than or equal to this zone mean ÷ number of valid zones; empirical rank within this image only
metadata.fertilizer_boost_formula: Mg_i=Bi*Mg_max; N_i=Bi*N_max; annual zone nutrient kg=annual nutrient kg/ha*zone area ha
metadata.ground_area_source: user-supplied mapping/uniform area when provided; otherwise estimated as detected tree count × 10 m × 10 m, not from image pixels
metadata.vari_pixel_filter: Only finite VARI pixels with non-zero denominator inside ExG mask are included
metadata.zone_grouping: Approximate image-row clustering; columns use fixed spatial bins based on median within-row tree spacing so missing detections do not shift subsequent bins; zone bbox encloses detected member boxes only
metadata.coordinate_system: Pixel coordinates use origin (0,0) at top-left; bbox x1,y1 inclusive-ish and x2,y2 exclusive crop boundary. normalized_xyxy values are divided by original image width/height.
limitations: ExG is a heuristic vegetation mask and may include weeds or omit shaded palm leaves.
Zone rectangles are generated from spatial grouping of detected trees; they are not guaranteed to match actual plantation blocks or planting rows.
Zone VARI summarizes ExG-selected pixels in the union of member tree detection boxes; pixels in overlapping boxes are counted once.
The optional P25 blanket-boost mode is a configurable spatial rule, not an agronomic diagnosis; validate its VARI gap cutoff for the imagery and management plan.
VARI is an RGB vegetation index, not a direct diagnosis of palm health or fertilizer requirement.
Fertilizer rates and prices are illustrative/configurable and are not agronomic recommendations.
Reported fertilizer boosts and totals are elemental Mg or N quantities; they are not converted to product mass.

Ground zone areas are not derived from image pixels. If measured areas are not supplied, fertilizer quantities use an approximate 10 m palm spacing (0.01 ha per detected palm); actual zone area may differ.

recommendation.area_note: Approximate area from detected tree count × spacing²; default spacing is 10 m (midpoint of 9–11 m). Replace with measured zone areas when available.
